title: Wayfare Pass Billing Standard — Restored-Period Share of the Membership Fee
content:
# Restored-period share of the membership fee (Wayfare Pass)

**Standard.** When a past-due Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership is restored, the restoration payment takes the restored-period share of the membership fee. The restored-period share of the membership fee depends on how the restoration falls: for a monthly plan restored while the declined attempts recorded on the period's renewal are fewer than the plan's payment retries plus one, the share is the days from the restoration date through the last day of the period, both days counted, over the days in the period, both end days counted; for an annual plan restored while the declined attempts recorded on the period's renewal are fewer than the plan's payment retries plus one, the share is the whole calendar months of the period, counted from the period start's day of month, that begin after the restoration date, over twelve; any other restoration takes the full membership fee.

The membership fee is multiplied by the share as an exact fraction; the share is not rounded, and the payment is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## The attempt threshold, plan by plan

The declined attempts counted are those recorded on the membership ledger for the renewal of the billing period in force: the scheduled attempt and every retry.

| Plan | Billing period | Payment retries | Share by days or months applies while declined attempts are fewer than | Full fee from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | monthly | 3 | 4 (that is, 1 to 3 attempts) | 4 attempts |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | monthly | 3 | 4 | 4 attempts |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | monthly | 3 | 4 | 4 attempts |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | annual | 3 | 4 | 4 attempts |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | annual | 3 | 4 | 4 attempts |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | annual | 3 | 4 | 4 attempts |

## Input, judgement, output

| Plan type | Declined attempts on the period's renewal | Share of the membership fee |
|---|---|---|
| monthly | 3 or fewer | days from the restoration date through the period's last day, both counted, over the days in the period |
| annual | 3 or fewer | whole calendar months of the period, counted from the period start's day of month, beginning after the restoration date, over twelve |
| either | 4 or more | the full membership fee |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs)

1. Wayfare Pass Monthly, fee 9.99, period 1 June to 30 June (30 days), restored on 21 June with 2 declined attempts. Days 21 June to 30 June are 10, so the share is 10 over 30; 9.99 multiplied by 10 and divided by 30 is 3.33.
2. Wayfare Pass Annual, fee 96.00, period beginning 10 January, restored on 25 April with 1 declined attempt. Months of the period begin on the 10th; those beginning after 25 April are 10 May through 10 December, 8 months, so the share is 8 over 12 and the fee share is 64.00.
3. The same Wayfare Pass Annual membership restored on 10 May: the month beginning 10 May does not begin after the restoration date, so 7 months remain and the fee share is 56.00.
4. Wayfare Pass Monthly with 4 declined attempts on the period's renewal: the full fee of 9.99 is taken.
